Admission_Open_Details: Admissions are open twice a year for Spring and Fall intakes
Spring_Deadline_Message: Spring admissions usually close between January and February so apply as early as possible
Fall_Deadline_Message: Fall admissions usually close between August and September so early application is recommended
Application_Mode_Details: Students can apply through official website or by visiting campus physically
Entry_Test_Difficulty: Easy to Moderate basic level test
Interview_Details: No interview is required for most admissions
Eligibility_Details: Students must have at least 50 percent marks in Intermediate to be eligible
Merit_Explanation: Admission is mostly based on basic eligibility rather than high merit competition
Admission_Process: Apply form -> Submit documents -> Entry test -> Fee submission -> Admission confirmation
Admission_Process_Details: First student submits application then documents are verified followed by test and fee submission
Required_Documents: CNIC/B-Form; Matric Certificate; FSc Result; Passport Size Photos
Documents_Details: Basic academic and identity documents are required at the time of admission
Confirmation_Details: Admission is confirmed once the student submits the required fee
Student_Advice: Apply early to avoid missing deadlines and prepare basic concepts for entry test
General_Notes: Dates may vary slightly every year so always confirm from official source
